messages:
incident-bot: URGENT: p99 decode latency spike on prod (Wavefront alert) - 3.2x above SLO for last 5m. Affected routes: /v1/generate-stream, /v1/chat. Impact: streaming stalls, customer retries. Pager: sev=high. Link: https://wavefront.redwood/example-dashboard
maria (oncall): I see it. Taking ownership. Setting channel to incidents/wavefront. Anyone oncall for runtime? @kevin
kevin (eng-runtime): here. looking at last deploys. any kernel/driver rollouts in last 12h?
maria (oncall): checking deploy bot...
support-bot: Deploybot: release trt-driver/8.1.0 pushed to prod 3h ago by @deploy-bot (PR #4321)
maria (oncall): ok trt driver pushed 3h ago. kevin can you check kernel/compilepath toolchain hashes on serving nodes? suspecting kernel-side regression causing KV eviction paging.
kevin (eng-runtime): running quick audit. grabbing kernels list and nv driver versions.
kevin (eng-runtime): cmd:
```
ssh jump@prod-sherlock 'pssh -h nodes.txt "uname -r && nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version --format=csv"'
```
kevin (eng-runtime): results: subset of nodes on 6.2.14-rt, others on 6.2.9. TRT driver 8.1 present across all. Seeing few nodes with new compilepath libs (libcompilepath.so v1.9) in /opt/runtime.
ida (eng-sre): adding capacity/eviction metrics: wavefront shows kernel pagefaults rising on the nodes with 6.2.14-rt coincident with tail p99. KV cache evictions spike w/ streaming workloads.
maria (oncall): good signal. correlation looks strong. kevin - can you roll back the compilepath patch on a canary pool? maybe isolate nodes with older kernel vs newer.
kevin (eng-runtime): creating canary rollback group; prepping rebuild of runtime on canary with compilepath v1.8 (previous). give me 10m.
liam (eng-oncall): heads-up customer impact: 2 enterprise accounts reported retries, throughput drop ~15%. tagging AMs.
maria (oncall): runbooks: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/paging-tail. we'll follow mitigation section. ida please patch auto-evict thresholds to be more conservative while we investigate.
ida (eng-sre): increased slab/kv cache threshold via ops, watching. Also toggled kernel debug off on canary to reduce noise.
kevin (eng-runtime): rollback done on canary nodes (6 nodes). initial telemetry: p95 improved from 480ms->220ms, p99 still elevated. running extended test set.
support-bot: Incident log created: INC-2026-1768624300
maria (oncall): good. kevin, liaise with infra to schedule wider rollback if canary stays good. also check for specific compiler flag changes - GCC change? any new -fno-strict-aliasing or link-time-opt? those can change codegen for compilepath.
kevin (eng-runtime): digging into build CI. PR #4319 bumped -O3 and added -ffast-math in compilepath builds 3h ago. that aligns with timeline.
maria (oncall): that seems like the smoking gun. decide: revert compile flag change in CI and roll new build. Do we have a hotfix plan?
kevin (eng-runtime): yes. will revert flags, build runtime v2.3.4-hotfix, push to canary within 30m. coordinating with ida for deploy window.
ida (eng-sre): we'll hold autoscaler and drain affected nodes during deploy to avoid noisy migrations.
liam (eng-oncall): MH: Communicate to customers: we have a mitigation in canary, applying broader rollback if stable. I'll draft status message.
maria (oncall): timeline: T+10m verify canary p99, T+40m roll to 50% pool, T+90m full rollout, unless regression persists. current postmortem owners: kevin (root cause), ida (mitigation ops), maria (coord/comm)
kevin (eng-runtime): building hotfix now. artifacts uploading to staging.
maria (oncall): ping when artifacts ready. also attach heap/dmesg logs from affected nodes for postmortem. use /incident artifacts.
support-bot: Attachments uploaded: /incidents/1768624300/artifacts.tar.gz
kevin (eng-runtime): hotfix built. deploying to canary now. command:
```
helm upgrade runtime -f values-canary.yaml runtime-chart --set image.tag=v2.3.4-hotfix
```
ida (eng-sre): canary ANS check: p95 210ms, p99 320ms (down from 1.2s). wavefront shows eviction rate back to baseline on canary.
maria (oncall): :thumbsup: start staged rollout. liam please post interim status to customers and support channels.
liam (eng-oncall): posting now: "Interim: We've identified a runtime compile flag change tied to recent build which increased tail latency and KV evictions. A rollback hotfix is in canary with improved metrics; staged rollout starting." (cc @accounts)
kevin (eng-runtime): rolling to 50% now.
ida (eng-sre): monitoring for ripple effects, increasing retention on traces for 2h.
maria (oncall): good. keep this channel updated. assign action items in incident doc. we'll transition to postmortem after stable.
liam (eng-oncall): oncall handoff in 2h for follow-up, I'll keep watch until then.
maria (oncall): thanks all. closing active paging; keep channel open for follow-up notes and final RCA.
kevin (eng-runtime): note for RCA: avoid aggressive -ffast-math in compilepath; add perf-bench guard in CI comparing p99 decode on baseline before merge.
ida (eng-sre): will add rollback-automations and safer kernel rollout gating.
support-bot: Incident INC-2026-1768624300 status: mitigated -> monitoring
